analysis_role: Post-result falsification/sensitivity analysis of the already observed orientation-environment correspondence. This is not an independent preregistered confirmation and cannot establish causation or adaptation.
question: Is the observed East-Asian orientation-environment correspondence unusually strong relative to counterfactual orientation state maps that preserve the observed 5U/4D ecological-panel state count, and does that conclusion persist among counterfactuals with an orientation recurrence profile and relative-depth geometry close to the observed history?

frozen_panel.occurrence_gate: >=10 independent thinned environment-complete occurrences per taxon
frozen_panel.enumeration_rule: Enumerate all choose(9,4)=126 assignments of D to the frozen eligible taxa. Every assignment has exactly four D and five U states. The observed assignment is one member of this exhaustive set. No environmental value is shuffled or altered.

historical_counterfactual_rule.full_map: For each 9-taxon counterfactual, replace only those nine observed U/D states in the full orientation crosswalk. All other resolved states remain fixed and unresolved states remain {U,D} ambiguous.
historical_counterfactual_rule.topologies: Use the same first six AU-nonrejected optimized Comp1061 topologies as the frozen ecological analysis.
history_metrics: exact lower bound of mean relative lineage depth among globally minimum-cost histories
exact upper bound of mean relative lineage depth among globally minimum-cost histories
historical_counterfactual_rule.relative_depth_definition: For an admitted orientation tree with N tips and a changed edge subtending d descendant tips, D=(N-d)/(N-1); terminal=1; lower is deeper-permissive. This is topology only, not time.
historical_counterfactual_rule.recurrence_profile_match: A counterfactual is recurrence-profile matched only if its six-topology vector of minimum steps exactly equals the observed six-topology vector.
historical_counterfactual_rule.depth_distance: For a recurrence-profile-matched assignment, compute the median across six topologies of abs(lower_cf-lower_obs)+abs(upper_cf-upper_obs).
historical_counterfactual_rule.history_nearest_pool: Among recurrence-profile-matched assignments, retain the lowest 25% by depth_distance, including all ties at the 25th-percentile cutoff. Pool definition uses history only and is independent of environmental outcomes.
historical_counterfactual_rule.fail_closed: If fewer than 10 assignments are recurrence-profile matched or fewer than 10 remain in the history-nearest pool, that comparison is not_evaluable; do not widen the pool after viewing environmental results.

primary.biological_direction: downward/nodding D associated with higher precipitation seasonality
primary.signed_statistic: median across the six accepted topologies of standardized PGLS beta_D_minus_U_sd

secondary.biological_direction: downward/nodding D associated with lower annual mean temperature
secondary.signed_statistic: negative of the median across the six accepted topologies of standardized PGLS beta_D_minus_U_sd

environmental_estimands.standardization: Within the fixed 9-taxon panel, standardize each environmental axis by its sample mean and sample SD exactly as the frozen ecological-reach analysis.
environmental_estimands.covariance: Use Brownian covariance from each accepted topology exactly as in summarize_chapter2_ecological_explanatory_reach_v1.py.

counterfactual_rank_tests.exact_rank_fraction: Because the assignment set is exhaustive and includes the observed assignment, report count(T_cf >= T_observed)/N for the declared signed statistic; ties count as at least as extreme. This is a conditional randomization rank, not an independent confirmatory P value.
counterfactual_rank_tests.topology_sensitivity: Also report the corresponding exact rank fraction separately for each of the six accepted topologies; do not treat the six values as independent replicates.
counterfactual_rank_tests.reverse_world_calibration: Within each pool, report whether any counterfactual has the opposite signed direction (T<0), the most reverse statistic, and its historical distance. This tests whether the observed sign is mechanically forced by state counts/history geometry.

classification_rule.counterfactual_correspondence_strongly_s: For BIO15, exact rank fraction <=0.05 in all three evaluable pools and at least one opposite-direction counterfactual exists in the history-nearest pool.
classification_rule.counterfactual_correspondence_strengthen: BIO15 exact rank fraction <=0.05 in the all-126 and recurrence-profile pools, but the history-nearest pool either exceeds 0.05 or contains no opposite-direction counterfactual.
classification_rule.counterfactual_correspondence_not_streng: BIO15 fails the <=0.05 rank criterion in the recurrence-profile-matched pool, or that pool is not evaluable.
classification_rule.bio1_role: BIO1 is a frozen secondary axis and is reported analogously but does not change the primary BIO15 classification.

claim_boundary: This post-result analysis cannot retroactively convert the frozen primary ecological classification from unresolved to a preregistered confirmatory result.

A low conditional rank shows that the observed trait-environment correspondence is unusual relative to declared counterfactual state maps; it does not establish climatic selection, historical causation, plasticity or adaptation.
History matching conditions on recurrence and topology-only depth geometry; it does not condition on all unmeasured lineage properties or geography.

Opposite-direction counterfactuals demonstrate that the sign is not mathematically forced by the declared state-count/history constraints; they are not claims about actual alternative evolutionary histories.
The nine-taxon ecological panel remains small and species-level centroids are not same-individual phenotype-environment measurements.
